title: Fix depth option description: 'Active Scan — Vulnerability detection + AD mapping' is wrong for web/API scans
goal: The wizard step 2 depth selection shows three cards: Passive / Active Scan / Full Pentest. The 'Active Scan' card description reads 'Vulnerability detection + AD mapping'. 'AD mapping' (Active Directory mapping) is a LAN/identity concept and is NOT performed during an External Web Active Scan. This description misleads web scan operators into thinking Active Directory will be probed when it will not. Fix: gate the description by selected tile type. For web/API tiles, show 'Vulnerability detection + web application analysis'. For LAN/AD tiles, keep 'Vulnerability detection + AD mapping'. In wizard.js, find where the depth choice cards are rendered and make the description conditional on the selected tile keys.
scope: Live audit 2026-05-01: screenshot wizard-complete-2026-05-01/external-web-s2-target-step.png shows External Web step 2 with Active Scan described as 'Vulnerability detection + AD mapping' — AD mapping is not applicable for web scans.
